blocks.text: BANGKOK — Why are goods expensive these days, vegetables easily bruised and the seasons so unpredictable? These changes are warning signs that the “global boiling crisis” is quietly eating into household budgets and affecting the food on our plates. It is time to recognize that this is a challenge close to home, requiring a smart, collective response before it is too late. Nature’s bill exceeds THB100 billion Many people remain unaware of the vast sums being lost as natural disasters take a heavy toll on Thailand’s economy and society.
